title: Jim Semivan won't say what is interesting about Sekret Machines

tellings.quote: He said, "Can you tell us what it is that's interesting about the book?" And he says, "No, I'm not going to tell you."

plain: Asked what was interesting about Sekret Machines, a book series put out by a man named Tom DeLonge, a man named Jim Semivan reportedly answered flatly: "No, I'm not going to tell you." The researcher Jason Simosa tells this on the show, summarising the exchange without naming where he heard it. He tells it because the refusal hints that the books hold something Semivan knows about and will not explain.
